AnnotationBand.description:
Which value axis of the pane an annotation's anchor prices are read on.
Omitted: the candles' price axis, so every call written before indicator
bands existed means what it always meant.

oneOf.description:
One indicator pane's own value axis, named by the `kind` and `ordinal`
the pane's indicators snapshot reports (`native.cvd`, `0`). Anchor
`price` is then that indicator's value: a CVD level, not a price.

AnnotationTarget.description:
Where an annotation goes. Omitting both halves means the chart the trader
is looking at — the same default the toolbar's own placement uses.

pane_side.description: The pane within that tab. Omitted: the pane drawings go to.

pane_slot.description:
Which context chart `pane_side = "time"` means, top to bottom from
`0`. Omitted: the top one. Ignored for the flow pane, which has no
stack to pick from.

tab_id.description: The tab, by the id every snapshot reports. Omitted: the active tab.

ChartAnnotationAnchor.description:
One coordinate from a chart gesture. Market time is retained when a bar
exists; `bar_position` keeps future chart space expressible without
inventing a timestamp.

description:
Ranged drawings share this future-aware input; the selected tool still
owns whether exactly two or three anchors complete it.

band.description:
The value axis the anchors' prices are on. Omitted: the price band.
An indicator band must be an indicator pane the target pane shows.

chart_reference.description:
Optional exact series identity. Absent: the original timestamp/future
behavior. Present: bar positions and supplied times must agree with
this pane's current series and active layout before anything is placed.
